experiment: E-COLLEGE-BACKFILL: populate the eFV production block for milb_missing college draftees from the validated college->Single-A translation
spec: trainability check pre-registered as the FIRST step (analog of the overseas item 15 method and the E-STUFF timing block); the modeling experiment runs ONLY if the resolved trainable cohort is non-trivial
hypothesis: college draftees who reach MLB with a thin/empty MiLB production block (milb_missing=1) could have k_rel/bb_rel imputed from their college tracked line via college_translation (hit_k is the one validated component, r2 ~0.30), giving the eFV ridge real production signal instead of the missingness indicator

method.join: efv_dataset matrix resolved-debuted rows (2011-2023 cohorts) with target_censored and consensus_fv_raw present; milb_missing = no 'milb' block; college line joined by normalized player name (college_translation.norm_name) against load_cs_hitters/load_cs_pitchers (CollegeSavant TrackMan tracked lines)
method.trainability_gate: STOP unless the resolved milb_missing college-joinable count is non-trivial per side (target: enough to hold out a per-side, no-degradation, thin-cohort rho check like item 15's method)

verdict: STOP - timing/coverage block, NO experiment run, data/xfv.json untouched. The intersection (resolved 2011-2023 debut cohort) x (empty production block) x (has an in-repo college tracked line) is 4 hitters / 3 pitchers, and these are cross-era name collisions, not real joins: CollegeSavant TrackMan ingestion covers roughly the 2021+ college classes, whose players have not resolved a 6-MLB-season WAR window (drafted ~2018+, debut ~2021+). A 'carlos martinez' debuting 2013 cannot carry 2021+ college TrackMan data; the apparent matches join a resolved veteran to a different, recent same-named amateur. Confirmed by the context count: only 5 of 796 resolved hitter rows join to ANY college line at all.
structural_reason: same class of block as E-STUFF (AAA aStuff+ overlay): the feature source (college TrackMan / AAA tracking) starts after the resolved-outcome cohort ends. There is no data engineering fix on the current vintage; it resolves with time.
reopen_trigger: resolved 2024+ debut cohorts (players who were drafted with college TrackMan coverage AND have since accrued a scorable MLB WAR window). Re-run the trainability check then; only feed the validated component(s) (hit_k; hit_bb caveated; never hit_ops / pit_k, which are r2 < 0.05).
do_not_retry: the eFV college backfill against the 2011-2023 resolved vintage - it is coverage-empty by construction, not under-optimized.
